title: intro-eduResearchR
text: One possible research question using MathAchieve : relationship students’ socioeconomic status mathematics achievement? following graph visualizes relationship SES MathAch:  graph allows researchers visually examine whether differences socioeconomic status associated differences mathematics achievement.
code: ggplot(MathAchieve, aes(x = SES, y = MathAch)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +   labs(     title = "Socioeconomic Status and Mathematics Achievement",     subtitle = "MathAchieve dataset",     x = "Socioeconomic Status (SES)",     y = "Mathematics Achievement"   ) +   theme_minimal() #> `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

title: A Collection of Educational Datasets for Research and Statistical Analysis
text: 15 datasets included eduResearchR curated organized standard R packages facilitate educational research applied statistical analysis: apipop.rda: Academic Performance Index student school-level dataset. CASchools.rda: California Test Score Data school districts. classroom.rda: Classroom-level data student achievement instruction. collegeDistance.rda: High School Beyond dataset higher education accessibility. EducationLiteracy.rda: Cross-national indicators educational literacy attainment. ExamScores.rda: Student examination scores performance metrics. FirstYearGPA.rda: First-year college GPA academic predictor variables. MathAchieve.rda: Mathematics achievement scores high school students. NELS.rda: National Education Longitudinal Study (NELS) 1988 dataset school effectiveness. pisausa.rda: Program International Student Assessment (PISA) data United States. school.rda: Institutional indicators structural school characteristics. schoolProgram.rda: Evaluation data school academic programs interventions. schools.rda: Census demographic data across primary secondary schools. STARplus.rda: STAR project dataset class size reduction student achievement non-experimental controls. STUDENT.rda: Student-level demographic academic performance records.
